summary: LOT 2 'Offrir GénéraQuiz' + new pricing tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (offers/promo toggle + validation, gift checkout -> Stripe URL, blank names 422, gift package rejected on /checkout/session, unpaid order status, admin code create/PDF/wrong-key 404/lookup normalisation/cancel, redeem famille_v2 +365d / 409 / 404 / extension from current expiry keeping higher tier, family space owner/proche/limits/402/accept/409 reuse/remove/quitter, challenges gate for proche vs outsider). Frontend: /app/pricing (3 cards, yearly default, monthly 4,90/7,90, badge, access lines, no strike/Héritage, gift cards w/ API prices + promo strike, printed book 79,90), landing #tarifs, /offrir (offer picker, family table only famille, validation, Stripe redirect, promo hero title+strike, 390px no overflow), /activer (preview, register/login links w/ next, login->submit->success with expiry, already-activated), /app/famille owner/proche/none, /famille/rejoindre accept flow, admin /app/admin/cadeaux via nav-admin-trigger -> nav-admin-gifts (stats, create, PDF, cancel, promo save), /app/account links all work. Found 1 HIGH integration bug (proche blocked by frontend paywall on /app/challenges/new) and 1 MEDIUM UX bug (code auto-format corrupts a code typed character-by-character including the 'GQ-' prefix). Gift promo left DISABLED with defaults (verified via API).

minor.issue: Lifetime premium users without plan_expires_at (e.g. admin-type lifetime accounts) redeeming a gift get base=now and plan_expires_at=now+365 -> they LOSE lifetime access. Should skip setting expiry (or keep lifetime) when user has no plan_expires_at and is premium.
PDF still served for cancelled codes (no status check). Low risk (needs pdf_key) but a cancelled card can still be printed/shared.
origin_url is not validated against allowed origins (success/cancel URL can point to any domain - open redirect after Stripe payment).

Invitation is not bound to the invited email (any logged-in user with link can accept) and a Famille owner can accept another family's invite (becomes owner + proche). Acceptable for MVP, flag for product decision.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing the printed code key-by-key 'GQ-U3VS-K972' yields 'GQ-GQU3-VSK9' (first 'G' is auto-prefixed to 'GQ-G', then the typed 'Q' is kept as code char). Lookup then returns 'introuvable'. Paste and typing without prefix work. Seniors will typically type the code exactly as printed. Fix: don't auto-prefix while the raw input is only 'G'/'GQ' (or strip a leading 'GQ' from the raw value before stripping non-alnum only when input already begins with 'GQ-'), or format on blur.

integration_issues.flow: Proche (free plan) launches a family challenge
integration_issues.issue: ChallengeNew.jsx line 21 gates on user.plan !== 'premium' and shows 'Réservé aux Premium'. Proches who joined a family (backend allows POST /api/challenges, verified 200) are blocked from 'Lancer un défi' (famille-new-challenge). Core promise of the new Famille model broken in UI. Fix: expose family access in /api/auth/me (e.g. has_family_access / family_owner_id) or call GET /api/famille in ChallengeNew and allow role owner/proche.

issues: Table 3rd column ('LES 4 PROCHES' / 'Abonnement personnel nécessaire') is clipped at the right edge inside its container (no page overflow, but text cut). Consider stacked card layout on mobile.

Create-code form fields not cleared after successful creation.
Subscription badge shows generic 'Premium actif' - plan name (Famille/Solo) not shown.

Two similar fields: 'Ajouter un code cadeau' (promo code input, placeholder FAMILLE2026) rejects GQ- gift codes with 'Code invalide ou expiré' while a separate link 'Activer une carte cadeau (GQ-…)' exists - confusing; rename promo field to 'code promo' or route GQ- codes to /api/gifts/redeem.
Hero always advertises Famille offer/price even when Solo is preselected (design choice, but may confuse).
Leaderboard row cramped at 390px ('0 parties · 0 %' wraps over 2 lines).
